reviews.comment: Professor Ball is good professor; he will cover the material in class that covers what the homework asks of you. Very friendly if you make an attempt before asking questions, but if not then he will encourage you to figure it out. Lectures are very funny and friendly if everyone participates, so don't be afraid of his tough love.

Prof. Ball is a good professor. He gives fantastic lessons & labs that stretch your brain, but put the onus on you to learn. What Professor Ball is even better at is being an exceptional leader. Professor Ball doesn't take excuses, he pushes the best version of you to constantly be present. He makes exceptional engineers and even better people.

he is not really helpful since most questions you ask him, he responds with "figure it out" but I that helped me learn how to resolve things by myself. Everything was alright the only thing is that he didn't grade the final project which is what I needed for an A in his class. He yaps and jokes a lot in class. Funny but wouldn't take him again.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I overall liked the class, the peer teacher helps a ton, so make sure you run every HW by them before submitting. The labs were brutal though, the TA takes points off for no reason, would've gotten an A in the class since I got 100s on everything BUT the labs.

Oooooof, this class is just brutal. Yeah sure Professor Ball could've made it easier but this class is overall very time consuming if you don't have experience with python or if you don't have any interest in it. He'll say it's not a weed out course, but it is.

Took him in the academy for 3 semesters. Ball is a great person and has my respect, but you should expect to learn a lot of the content on your own, especially in 216/217. He does give pop quizzes, but also gives partial credit. I mostly enjoyed his funny remarks and enthusiasm
Awesome Professor, great role model. I really enjoyed the two semesters I was lucky to have professor ball as an instructor.

Lovable and great professor, but the exams are a killer. You can't really blame him, though, since the exams are made and designed by A&M. (Side-note: For those who are joining the Engineering Academy, I cannot emphasize enough to NOT underestimate the exams. Review like crazy).

He is ok at best. You often go up to him to ask a question, and he will look at you like you are stupid and make you figure out the answer by yourself. You will have to figure out a lot of stuff by yourself. The main way you learn is through modules on a website but the questions there don't help. It is very easy to get lost and behind in class
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: For starters, Professor Ball really DOES care about his students. Any personal issues that students are going through he makes sure to help them in any way he can. That being said, his teaching style is extremely blunt. You will be doing a lot of learning on your own as the lecture material and instruction is almost worthless. Room for improvement.

If you don't put in the time outside of class you will fail. He cares about his students but if you don't show that you have put in the effort he won't care when you ask him questions. Very little curving on exams so you have to put in the time before you take the test. All around great professor as he shows how important preparing is.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Not super serious but wont take you seriously if you dont apply yourself. If you do the bare minimum, you WILL fail.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof ball isnt terrible, but he isnt great. He says he wont curve, but Bc the average was so low he did curve the final. He definitely isnt great at grading or feedback & I wouldnt outright recommend him. He cares about his students but he doesnt express it in the way he grades them.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Ball is the worst Professor Ive ever had. He does NOT understand how students learn and gives exams that are NOTHING like the homework or the labs you do. NEVER take him if you have a choice. He does NOT curve or give extra credit and is all around awful.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader
